- ProofWriter: [Logic-LLM GitHub](https://github.com/teacherpeterpan/Logic-LLM) `outputs/logic_programs/ProofWriter_dev_gpt-4.json`（GPT-4 生成的 DSL 标注，600 题均衡分布）
